RERA Registration in India: A Complete Guide

The  was introduced to promote transparency, accountability, and efficiency in India’s real estate sector. RERA registration is required for eligible real estate projects and agents, helping establish a regulated framework and protect the interests of homebuyers. Taxswami assists developers, builders, and agents with the registration process.

RERA provides a regulatory framework for the real estate sector and aims to improve transparency in property transactions. It requires eligible projects and agents to comply with prescribed disclosure, registration, and regulatory requirements.
Eligible projects, generally including those exceeding  or having more than , must be registered, subject to applicable exemptions.
Agents facilitating the sale or purchase of properties in registered projects generally require registration with the respective state RERA authority.
Projects meeting the applicable criteria and not having received a completion certificate may also require registration.
